name: tg-shop-v2
description: Monorepo root: shared library + customer Mini App + admin panel + public website

scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w frontend-admin && npm run build -w site
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared -w frontend -w frontend-admin -w site
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared -w frontend -w frontend-admin -w site -w e2e
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared -w frontend -w frontend-admin -w site
